class_index.scope: List of fully qualified class names once observed by Poggit CI; no PHP implementations, source revision, dependency edges or version identity.

external_scan_method: Read bounded Git ZIPs, nested ZIPs, and regular PHAR file entries. Source ZIP roots, CRC, byte sizes and SHA-256 recorded. Searched all six target namespaces . No PHP source, PHAR stub or serialized metadata was executed.
external_scan_limits: These selected public server packs and development builds do not cover all PHARs ever published. GitHub code search does not reliably index binary PHARs. A library with all identifying names removed can be missed.

class_fingerprint_scan.method: Prefilter cached PHAR bytes for distinctive class filenames and strings from the Wayback class index; verify SHA-256 and size; read candidate regular entries with PHP Phar without executing source or deserializing metadata. This supplements, and does not replace, the earlier namespace scan.
class_fingerprint_scan.limitations: A raw-byte prefilter can miss a completely compressed outer archive or renamed files and identifiers. A shared class name does not establish provenance or version. Candidates were not accepted as recovered source.
